project_info.theme: Toyota genuine brake fluid protection and braking confidence
project_info.color_palette: Red, Black, White, Metallic Silver, Warm Sunset Beige

main_subject.detail: A large Toyota DOT4 brake fluid bottle with a red cap dominates the right side foreground, backed by a dramatic close-up of a brake disc and caliper; a white Toyota Corolla Cross appears small at the lower left on a road scene.
main_subject.style: Hybrid photoreal product key visual with premium ad compositing, glossy packaging, metallic brake texture, and bold editorial typography.

composition_elements.text:
DAU PHANH DOT 4
NANG CAP BAO VE, HANH TRINH VUNG TIN
BAO VE HE THONG PHANH
HIEU SUAT PHANH ON DINH
TOYOTA CHUAN QUOC TE DOT 4
Move your world
TOYOTA
500mL
items: Top Left: Huge black headline 'DAU PHANH' and 'DOT' with oversized red number '4' and a red underline accent.
Top Right: White Toyota logo on dark mechanical background.
Bottom Left: White Corolla Cross on a curving road with warm cityscape silhouette and bridge in the distance; three icon callouts above the car.
Bottom Right: Handwritten white 'Move your world' over glossy black floor reflection.
Center/Background: Giant brake fluid bottle, diagonal translucent red shape, and macro brake rotor and caliper close-up.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: High contrast product lighting, glossy highlights on bottle and metal parts, subtle sunset haze in the left background, dramatic red reflections, sharp packaging readability.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Toyota genuine DOT4 brake fluid. Centerpiece is a large silver brake-fluid bottle with red cap on the right foreground, beside a realistic close-up brake disc and caliper, with a small white Toyota Corolla Cross on a road at lower left. Background is a clean warm-to-dark composite with diagonal red translucent graphics and mechanical textures. Surrounding elements: bold Vietnamese headline 'DAU PHANH DOT 4', red slanted banner 'NANG CAP BAO VE, HANH TRINH VUNG TIN', three monochrome line icons with captions, Toyota logo at top right, handwritten 'Move your world' at bottom right. Technical style: photorealistic commercial product poster compositing, studio-commercial composite lighting, glossy highlights, dramatic red reflections, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
